title: WikiFake — can you spot the false facts?
description: A Wikipedia article, a handful of facts rewritten by a model, and you. Find them alone or against other players — a free game of critical reading and fact-checking.
tagline: Find the facts a model rewrote. Free, and no account.
imageAlt: WikiFake: “Who is lying?”, over a paragraph of a French Wikipedia article with one falsified figure marked.
